posts.title: Journey so far [to PMC] & beyond
posts.description: This is a very quick post tbh, and kinda personal. Growing up, I wasn’t great at sports. I also wasn’t great at much else – it took until university to figure out what I was actually good at, which turned out to be computation. That part clicked. Sports remained an open problem. Part of that is the label: when team sports leave you out early, “athlete” stops feeling like a word that belongs to you

posts.title: Moonshot: Project Escalion
posts.description: Why do we love to do moonshot projects, despite knowing that the odds are not exactly in your favor? There’s a very narrow line of difference between a “hobby project”, and a “moonshot project”. A hobby project does not demand anything, and nothing much is expected out of it.
